metadata.name: reflect_on_result
metadata.description: Reflects on whether a stored subagent result satisfies the original objective and writes a compact assessment back to shared memory.

objective.description: The original objective the result should satisfy.

memory_key.description: The memory key containing the result to evaluate.

output_key.description: The memory key where the reflection should be stored.

parent_skeleton:
# Skill: Reflect on Result

## Purpose
Evaluate whether a stored result appears to satisfy the objective and preserve a compact reflection for the workflow.

reflect_on_result.name: reflect_on_result
